lines.text: Zanzibar, 1896. A new sultan seized the throne. Britain said: gone by nine in the morning.

lines.text: At nine, the warships opened fire. The royal yacht sank almost at once.

lines.text: At nine thirty-eight, the flag came down. The sultan fled to the German consulate.
